text:
tessa: Quick check-in for HelioChip alpha preview. Goals: NDA signed, bench script sanity, infra access, and a short SI-run checklist for integration partners. Who owns what?
ajay: I have the HelioChip NDA draft (Helio_Redwood_Alpha_NDA_2026.pdf). Uploaded to legal drive. Waiting on Helio's GC signature.
diego: I'll own the bench script. Plan: two passes - perf sweep (vary seq and batch) and stability (long-run memory leak). Will add a --marketplace-tag for later marketplace listing metadata.
rachel: Product note: marketplace listing needs a short spec (region availability, SLA tier, model variants). We should draft a stub now so marketing can review.
ops-bot: Reminder: hardware access requires signed NDA + access request ticket in #eng-infra. Ticket template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/Helio-Access-Req
tessa: Good call ops-bot. @diego can you paste the harness prototype here when ready? Also we need a minimal telemetry schema for Helio so SI teams can map counters.
diego: Harness prototype:```\n./heliobench --model rwd-tiny-7b-q4 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --iters 1000 \n  --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.internal/v2/collect \n  --tags partner:HelioChip,preview:alpha,marketplace:pending\n```
diego: I'm collecting metrics: throughput_tok_s, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, gpu_mem_free_mb, model_load_ms, quant_mode. Will include host_cpu_pct and temp_c for ops.
ajay: Legal flagged ownership clause: Helio requests joint use of anonymized benchmark graphs; they specifically want to include Redwood numbers in co-marketing slides. Sophia?
sophia: (in legal thread) Suggest amendment: co-marketing allowed after mutual sign-off on results; Redwood retains final approval on any slide that includes proprietary perf curves. Add 30-day embargo post-run for embargoed numbers.
tessa: That works. Ops: schedule lab time? We prefer Wed 09:00-12:00 for a dry-run and Thu 22:00-02:00 for overnight stability run.
ops-bot: Lab availability: Wed 09:00-12:00 OK for 1 x Helio-S16 node; Thu overnight requires ops approval. Submit ticket with run_id and signed NDA.
drago: (added by diego in thread) Sample JSON payload (compact): {"run_id":"uuid-1234","partner":"HelioChip-alpha","model":"rwd-tiny-7b-q4","seq":2048,"batch":4,"throughput_tok_s":980.3,"latency_p95_ms":78.4}
rachel: Marketplace stub: regions: us-west1, eu-west1; SLA: best-effort alpha; pricing: TBD; notes: limited to preview customers. I'll put PR in the docs repo.
ajay: On feedback loops: propose weekly sync during alpha (Mon standup) and a shared feedback doc with tagged issues (perf/regressions/compat).
tessa: Agreed. Diego, can you enable a flag --anon-aggregates-only for runs shared with Helio? We should avoid sending raw traces unless explicitly requested.
diego: Added --anon-aggregates-only. Also added a --si-debug-token flag that gates raw trace upload to a signed URL for 7 days.
sophia: Legal approves the debug token flow but requires automatic deletion and audit logging. Add clause in NDA amendment.
tessa: Perfect. Marketing hold: do not publish anything until joint announcement checklist done. Rachel, can you own the announcement checklist?
rachel: On it. I'll draft a checklist: NDA signed, perf verified, image approvals, legal sign-off, embargo window, partner quotes.
ops-bot: Action items created: HELIO-ALPHA-1 (attach signed NDA), HELIO-ALPHA-2 (bench dry-run Wed), HELIO-ALPHA-3 (overnight stability Thu pending ops approval).
ajay: Looping in @sophia and @ops on #legal-partnerships and #eng-infra.
tessa: Thanks all. Next sync Fri 11:00 unless countersign completes earlier.
